title: George Wein
summary: He worked for George Wein on many dates and felt part of his family.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Who booked those things for you?
Have you done a lot of work for George Wein?
What were some of the things that you've done with him?
So many I can't tell you. All through Boston and didn't charge him nothing.
How do you mean didn't charge him nothing?

I just liked him that much, he and his whole family. I just felt like I was in the family. The last time I played in his house Mary Lou Williams was out there. Boy, it was cold, not c-o-l-d but k-o-l-d. So after we finished working we went out... That was the last time I went out there. I saw Mary Lou a couple of times...
